office: the Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP)

routes.label: online or at a service centre, delivered by courier: 5 days
urgent, at an ICP service centre: within 24 hours, AED 150 more

note: For UAE citizens. The ICP's service card for a new card: 5 years and AED 100 under 21, 10 years and AED 200 over 21, AED 150 more for the urgent service at a service centre; the service takes 5 days. The 24-hour time of the urgent service is the UAE government portal's. Fingerprints and signature from 15.

sources.title: Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security, New Identity Card Issuance (service card, UAE Citizen)
sources.said: The national ID card is issued with a validity of 5 years for those under the age of 21, and 10 years for those over the age of 21. ... Fees for issuing a new national ID card for citizens under the age of 21, valid for 5 years. - 100 AED ... Fees for issuing a new national ID card for citizens over the age of 21, valid for 10 years. - 200 AED ... Urgent service fees (available only at the Authority’s service centers) - 150 AED ... Service Completion Duration 5 Days

sources.title: The United Arab Emirates' Government portal, Emirates ID
sources.said: ICP provides an urgent service for issuing the Emirates ID card within 24 hours. The service is for UAE nationals, and GCC nationals residing in the UAE.
